exposed_results.e051_mechanism: Ongoing mismatch removes returning-edge fallback without impairing original-writer terminal performance in the studied conditions

decisions: Use all original generation-14 records and all 16 blocks rather than select failures or repair beneficiaries.
Keep prior injury/reset/base-noise identities so matched trajectories serve as exact exposed replay controls.
Change only ongoing cue-noise correlation; retain matched teaching and resets and fixed marginal noise variance.
Cross three correlations with unchanged baseline and repeated repair; no one-time or shuffled branches in this question.
Primary is repair minus baseline uninterrupted success under independent noise; no minimum-effect or equivalence margin selected.
Report changes in each absolute success rate and the repair advantage separately to distinguish baseline catch-up from reduced repair performance.
Record fallback and returning-edge counts as descriptive mechanism evidence, without mediation or causal attribution claims.
Benchmark exposed outcomes and synthetic Gaussian draws only; freeze before new mismatched cohort dynamics.
Allow 180 CPU minutes as a forecast admission ceiling for six branches and added noise audits; use one worker and no automatic scientific polling.
